uses.text-generate: Ask questions, draft text and summarize information in apps that use this capability.
uses.image-generate: Create images in your creative apps. Model details explain supported generation and editing features.
uses.audio-transcribe: Turn recorded speech into text for notes, subtitles and transcription.
uses.audio-synthesize: Read text aloud with voices supported by your chosen model.
uses.audio-separate: Separate vocals and accompaniment to prepare audio for editing.
uses.music-generate: Generate music and audio ideas in supported creative apps.
uses.music-transcribe: Estimate a score and musical events from an existing recording, then review them alongside the original audio.
uses.audio-voice-convert: Retarget an existing singing performance to a different voice while keeping its melody, lyrics and timing.
uses.video-generate: Create video with the inputs and controls supported by the selected model.
uses.voice-create: Create reusable voices from supported voice descriptions or reference recordings.
uses.text-annotate: Break text into sentences and words, marking parts of speech and grammar for subtitle, translation, and other text apps.
uses.text-decide: Let apps choose from given options or evaluate whether a statement about text or data holds true, with a probability for each answer.
uses.text-embed: Represent text for semantic search and other app features.
uses.image-face-swap: Replace faces in images using supported inputs and models.
uses.video-face-swap: Apply face replacement to video in supported apps.
uses.vision-locate: Locate objects or regions in images for visual tools.
uses.audio-speaker-embed: Extract speaker vectors from short audio without inferring identity.
